name: Enterprise Messaging Groups — Architecture & Technical Design
honestAssessment: Design and baseline audit complete. Phase 22.2 already provides Conversation.type=GROUP, roles, invites, mentions, and shared DirectMessage store. Phase 29 program extends this foundation; it is not a greenfield messenger. Full enterprise surface (wizard, SECRET, permission matrix engine, join requests, content policies, admin console, polls/events, analytics) is specified for phased delivery 29.1–29.7.

criteria.description: Backend messaging architecture audited (schema, routes, sockets, group 22.2)
Frontend messaging surfaces audited (Messages, dock, GroupManagePanel, create/join)
Explicit separation from Community Groups/Channels/Business Pages
Mandate single DirectMessage + Conversation graph; additive schema only
Invariants documented for zero DM/regression tolerance
Default role/permission matrix and evaluation order defined
Backward-compatible API and additive socket events specified
Phases 29.1–29.7 with no auto-deploy and completion gates
Rollback philosophy for additive migrations and FE/BE revisions
Production code changes for feature (expected NONE in 29.0)

gapsDeferredToLaterPhases: Join request table and QR/maxUses invites (29.1)
Send-path block + slow mode + content gates (29.1–29.2)
rollbackPlan: N/A — documentation only; no production change
risks: Large product scope — mitigated by hard phase gates
Naming collision with prior Android Phase 29 push work — messaging groups program documented separately; store versions remain 1.1.x independent
